newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Merrill, IFCI to lead $100-200 mln Uneximbank bond.
newsitem.headline: Merrill, IFCI to lead $100-200 mln Uneximbank bond.

text.p: Russia's third biggest bank as measured by assets, Uneximbank, said on Thursday Merrill Lynch and Russia's International Company for Finance and Investments (IFCI) bank will lead its Eurobond, with a road-show to start on July 7.

"Lead-managers for Uneximbank's Eurobond placement will be Merrill Lynch and Bank IFCI," a bank's spokesman told Reuters, confirming the bond would be between $100-$200 million with a three to five year tenor.
The spokesman declined to say when the roadshow would finish or in which cities it would take place, but he said the placement would be a public one and be completed by mid-July.
Uneximbank privately placed a $50 million three-year FRN via Merrill Lynch in January. The bonds were issued by its Dutch subsidiary Unexim International Finance B.V.
Moody's ratings agency has assigned Unexim International Finance B.V. a prospective rating of Ba3 for its Eurobond issue, which is guaranteed by Uneximbank.
